cover_letter:
Dear Aikido team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Operations Associate position. Aikido's developer-first approach to security and your rapid growth caught my attention—I'm drawn to the opportunity to learn how a B2B SaaS growth engine really works and to contribute to a team that values ownership and speed.

My background sits at the intersection of marketing, data, and technology. As a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist, I've built and optimized websites, implemented structured data, and used tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and report on results. In my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage CMS content, run technical SEO audits, and ensure data accuracy across client sites. I've also developed automation scripts in Python and integrated AI tools to streamline repetitive tasks—skills that align with your need for reliable data and scalable processes.

What excites me about this role is the focus on structure and systems. I enjoy cleaning up data, documenting processes, and building reports that help teams make informed decisions. I'm comfortable working with spreadsheets and dashboards, and I pay close attention to detail—whether it's a JSON-LD schema or a CRM record. I'm eager to support Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships by keeping operations running smoothly and enabling faster execution.

I'm looking for a role where I can grow quickly and take real ownership. Aikido's high-trust, informal culture and emphasis on talent and drive appeal to me. I'm confident that my technical and operational skills can help your team move fast without breaking things.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to Aikido's mission.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Strong attention to detail and love for structured, clean data: implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and llms.txt for mirook.com, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised search-health scores.
• Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and reporting: daily use of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and create reports for client websites.
• Experience with marketing and sales processes: managed CMS content, ran technical SEO audits, and supported lead management through data enhancement and segmentation for client sites.
• Automation and tool proficiency: used Python automation and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to streamline repetitive tasks; integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools.
• Eager to learn and grow in a fast-moving B2B SaaS environment: currently pursuing HubSpot Content Marketing certification and applying SEO/analytics skills in freelance and junior roles.
